evals.prompt: I have changes across auth middleware and the dashboard UI, help me commit them properly
evals.expected_output: Two groups in .git/commits.json with conventional messages, plus the git group-commit runner; no commits created
assertions: commits.json groups array contains one entry per feature group in commit order
each message follows conventional commit format: type(scope): description
each group's message is scoped to that group's files only, not the full diff
no git commit is executed; user is told to run git group-commit

evals.prompt: Generate a commit message for my staged changes
evals.expected_output: commits.json with exactly one entry; full message also printed inline
assertions: commits.json groups array has exactly one entry
the standalone-build isolation check is skipped
the full commit message is printed inline in the summary
message follows conventional commit format with imperative mood header

evals.prompt: I just finished fixing a bug, help me write a good commit
evals.expected_output: Generates a fix-type conventional commit message via the group flow
assertions: scope reflects the area of the bugfix

evals.prompt: The commit task failed on group 2, I fixed the hook, regenerate
evals.expected_output: Committed groups are pruned from the groups array
assertions: groups whose files are all clean in git status are removed
only uncommitted groups remain in .git/commits.json, order preserved

evals.prompt: Write a PR description for my branch
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT activate (this is PR description, not commit message)
